name: typofix
description: Checks the spelling and grammar of your prompt as you type, with 3 fixes for each mistake, and rewrites the whole draft with Haiku when you ask.

language.title: Spelling language
language.description: A language code such as en_US or de. Leave empty to detect the language automatically.

hunspell.title: hunspell dictionary
hunspell.description: On macOS, hunspell also checks English words with this dictionary, such as en_US or en_GB, to catch typos macOS accepts. Leave empty to not use hunspell.
